name: global-shopaholics
description: Buy from any US store for you: ship worldwide or in the US, find it cheaper, pay in crypto. Live shipping rates, landed cost, US buy-for-me, crypto checkout, tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Buy from US stores, ship anywhere
interface.longDescription: Get live DHL, FedEx, UPS and USPS rates from the Global Shopaholics US warehouse to any country, estimate the total landed cost of a US purchase including customs duties and import taxes, get a free US shipping address, and ask Global Shopaholics to buy an item from any US store for you. GS confirms every order and its total by email before buying; nothing is charged in chat. Legal items only.
defaultPrompt: How much does it cost to ship a 5 kg box from the US to Nigeria?
I want a $300 Dyson from Amazon delivered to Angola. What will I pay in total?
Can you buy this US product for me and ship it to Saudi Arabia?

positive.prompt: How much to ship 5 kg from the USA to Angola?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live DHL/FedEx/UPS/USPS options sorted cheapest first with transit times; notes duties are excluded.

positive.prompt: I want to buy a $250 pair of headphones in the US and ship them to the UK. What is the total including VAT?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns item + GS fee + shipping + estimated UK VAT/duty as a labelled estimate range.

positive.prompt: What does Global Shopaholics charge to buy something for me, and how can I pay?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the Assisted Purchase fee (0% bank transfer/crypto, otherwise 5% with a $5 minimum) and payment methods with source links.

positive.prompt: I need a US address to shop on Amazon from Pakistan.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives sign-up steps for the free GS US address and how forwarding works.

positive.prompt: I live in Hawaii and this store will not ship to me. Can you buy it and find it cheaper?
positive.expected_behavior: Collects links, ship-to state/ZIP, name and email, confirms, then submits; promises no prices.

positive.prompt: GS quoted me $120. I want to pay with USDC.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a BTCPay checkout link after confirming amount and email; notes 0% crypto fee.
Returns the official DHL tracking link.

negative.prompt: Buy a handgun in the US and ship it to me in Brazil.
Charge my card now and complete the order.
Just send an assisted purchase request for some shoes with any email.

review.commerce_description: The plugin quotes shipping and sends purchase requests to the Global Shopaholics team. It does not take payment in chat; crypto payments happen on GS's BTCPay checkout page; GS invoices customers by email after confirming the order.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live shipping rates, landed cost with duties, services and fees, US address sign-up, assisted purchase and shipment requests, tracking links.
